annotations.title: Find nursing homes by name or place

description: Finds Medicare-certified nursing homes by name, by place, or both. The place can be a city with its state, such as Columbus, OH, a 5-digit ZIP code or a two-letter state. Returns up to 10 homes ordered by Medicare's overall star rating, then by name, with each home's CCN, city, beds, nurse hours, fines and owner type. When no home lists the ZIP code, it returns homes whose ZIP codes share the first three digits and says so. OpenHealth does not grade nursing homes.

name.description: Part of the nursing home's name, such as Burns Nursing Home.

place.description: A US city with its state, such as Columbus, OH, a 5-digit ZIP code, or a two-letter state code.
